member: a centrifugal compressor with an anti-surge recycle valve, a low-pressure-ratio blower of about 0.5 MW supplying a 24 kPa header; the task represents the family of centrifugal compressors with an anti-surge recycle (compressor_surge/PHYSICS.md:5-7, 635)

valve_lag.why: ours, family: a dead time before the valve moves, inside C7's 150 to 300 ms; 0.15 is the lower end (compressor_surge/PHYSICS.md:24, 100; env.py:121-125)

drive_rate.why: ours (3 %/s, TUNED); the two readings of Gravdahl et al. 2002 Table 2, 1.66 %/s (rad/s^2) to 10.4 %/s (rev/s^2), converted from % per s to a fraction; compressor_surge/PHYSICS.md:626-640. Source-reading bounds, not a stated family range: confirm before use; the ends are the two published readings, not a stated family range (owner, 2026-11-12)

reset_margin.why: ours, family: the control line the plant is established on at reset and after a trip; about 10 % [C6], 10 to 15 % [C1]; 0.10 is the lower end (compressor_surge/env.py, established_point; PHYSICS.md, version 4, Episode)

line_shift_max.why: ours, family: how far a machine's true surge line may sit from the map its controller reads, drawn either side each episode; invariant coordinates leave 2.6 % (one change of inlet condition) to 7 % (combined) at low suction pressure [C14]; field and shop curves can differ by more [C1] (compressor_surge/env.py, line_shift_max; PHYSICS.md, version 4, the hidden line)
